name: Piper
tagline: Fast, lightweight local text-to-speech engine designed for offline voice synthesis on modest hardware.
real_test_summary: Tested synthesizing speech locally from text offline with very low memory overhead. Responds quickly on lightweight hardware without requiring a dedicated GPU or cloud API calls.
pros: Extremely lightweight and fast even on CPU-only or low-RAM systems
Permissive MIT license with zero cloud usage limits or watermarks
Well-suited for offline assistants, notifications, and local scripts
cons: Voice expressiveness is more utilitarian than heavy cloud expressive voice models
Voice quality varies noticeably between individual voice checkpoints
